home.tagline: Four-year terms. Forty years of play. No ethics but your own.
home.neutral: You take office with no political stance. Campaign promises start at the 2nd election.

main.legendFigure: ≈ Figure revealed when the policy is enacted
main.pick: Select a policy on the network.
main.precedentsHidden: Leaders have done something similar before. Names appear once the policy is enacted.
main.zoomHint: Zoom out to group actions by field · drag to pan · scroll to zoom

groups.title: Voter groups
groups.heading: Public opinion
groups.overlap: A voter can belong to several groups · sizes add up to more than 100%
groups.alert: Revolutionaries have emerged ({{size}}% of the population). They support no government and may attempt an assassination.

summary.title: End of semester

headline.down: The government hardens, and the streets feel it

summary.toElection_one: {{count}} semester until the election. Active policies keep taking effect.
summary.toElection_other: {{count}} semesters until the election. Active policies keep taking effect.

event.label: Major event
event.headline: {{policy}}: the government puts it into practice
event.body: The decision echoes across {{country}}. Supporters celebrate; critics speak of a rupture.

buyback-record.title: Gun buyback program collects thousands of weapons
buyback-record.body: Exchange posts see long lines as authorities celebrate weapons taken off the streets.

school-shooting.title: Gunman opens fire at school, reigniting gun debate
school-shooting.body: The country mourns as the tragedy reopens the debate over gun ownership.

option.a: Declare mourning and defend gun rights

militia-takes-district.title: Armed militia seizes control of entire district
militia-takes-district.body: Residents report "protection fees" and clashes with police.

military-abuse-viral.title: Video of military abuse on the streets goes viral
military-abuse-viral.body: Footage of soldiers assaulting civilians spreads online, sparking outrage.

wrongful-execution.title: Execution revealed to be a fatal judicial error
wrongful-execution.body: New evidence surfaces months after the sentence was carried out, shocking the nation.

journalist-disappears.title: Government-critical journalist goes missing
journalist-disappears.body: Colleagues and press groups demand answers from the authorities.

organized-crime-wave.title: Organized crime wave hits major cities
organized-crime-wave.body: Robberies and extortion multiply, straining the local economy.

coup-rumors.title: Coup rumors circulate in the barracks
coup-rumors.body: Officers trade confidential reports as tension rises in the military high command.

police-strike.title: Police walk off the job over pay dispute
police-strike.body: Patrols thin out as businesses fear a rise in theft.

shortages.title: Price controls empty store shelves
shortages.body: Basic goods vanish from shelves as lines form outside supermarkets.

capital-flight.title: Investors rush to pull money out of the country
capital-flight.body: Stocks and the currency fall after signs of legal insecurity for private capital.

investment-boom.title: Investment wave follows market-friendly reforms
investment-boom.body: Companies announce new funding and job openings.

credit-downgrade.title: Rating agency downgrades the country's credit score
credit-downgrade.body: Borrowing costs rise on international markets.

currency-crisis.title: National currency collapses amid exchange crisis
currency-crisis.body: Prices spike and the government faces pressure to act fast.

commodity-boom.title: Commodity prices surge on international markets
commodity-boom.body: Exporters celebrate the extra foreign currency inflow.

commodity-crash.title: Commodity prices crash on international markets
commodity-crash.body: Export-driven sectors suffer from the sudden price drop.

global-recession.title: Global recession hits the country's economy
global-recession.body: The external crisis cuts exports and investment.

good-harvest.title: Record harvest eases food prices
good-harvest.body: Farms yield more than expected, helping curb inflation.

general-strike.title: General strike paralyzes key sectors
general-strike.body: Unions call a walkout in response to labor law changes.

union-agreement.title: Unions and companies reach a wage deal
union-agreement.body: The agreement avoids walkouts and is welcomed by workers.

hospital-queue-scandal.title: Hospital waiting lines expose healthcare crisis
hospital-queue-scandal.body: Patients report months-long waits for surgeries and appointments.

epidemic.title: Infectious disease outbreak spreads across the country
epidemic.body: Hospitals report strain as authorities closely monitor the situation.

medical-breakthrough.title: Medical breakthrough improves public healthcare
medical-breakthrough.body: New technology cuts lines and treatment wait times.

school-ranking-record.title: Country climbs in international education rankings
school-ranking-record.body: The result is met with pride by students and educators.

student-protests.title: Students take to the streets in protest
student-protests.body: Demonstrations demand changes to the school curriculum.

religious-march.title: March draws crowds in defense of traditional values
religious-march.body: Religious and conservative groups fill the country's main squares.

overdose-crisis.title: Overdose cases multiply in major cities
overdose-crisis.body: Health services report a rise in emergency admissions.

morality-police-incident.title: Morality enforcement leads to violent incident
morality-police-incident.body: Video of an aggressive stop shocks part of public opinion.

casino-laundering-scandal.title: Casinos implicated in money-laundering scheme
casino-laundering-scandal.body: Investigation finds betting used to disguise illicit funds.

environmental-disaster.title: Environmental disaster hits mining area
environmental-disaster.body: A spill contaminates rivers, alarming nearby communities.

energy-crisis.title: Energy crisis threatens the country's supply
energy-crisis.body: Reserves drop as the government weighs emergency measures.

climate-award.title: Country wins international environmental award
climate-award.body: The recognition highlights progress in protecting natural areas.

natural-disaster.title: Natural disaster strikes the country
natural-disaster.body: Rescue teams work to aid affected families.

migration-wave.title: New wave of migrants arrives in the country
migration-wave.body: Border towns see a rise in new arrivals.

labor-shortage.title: Labor shortage hits productive sectors
labor-shortage.body: Companies report trouble filling open positions.

hacker-leak.title: Hacker leak exposes surveillance data
hacker-leak.body: Documents reveal the scope of monitoring on ordinary citizens.

corruption-scoop.title: Report exposes new corruption scandal
corruption-scoop.body: Investigation finds public funds diverted in government contracts.

judges-resign.title: Supreme court justices resign en masse
judges-resign.body: The mass departure raises alarm over judicial independence.

leader-statue-toppled.title: President's statue toppled by protesters
leader-statue-toppled.body: The scene symbolizes the government's eroding popularity.

mass-rally.title: Rally draws crowds in support of the government
mass-rally.body: Supporters fill the main square in a show of popular strength.

palace-intrigue.title: Internal dispute stirs the corridors of power
palace-intrigue.body: Rumors of intrigue among the president's inner circle spread in the capital.

international-sanctions.title: Country hit by international sanctions
international-sanctions.body: Foreign governments respond to human rights violations with economic restrictions.

mass-protests.title: Mass protests sweep the country's main cities
mass-protests.body: Demonstrators demand answers from the government amid rising discontent.

sports-victory.title: National team wins international title
sports-victory.body: The country celebrates in the streets with a national party.

infrastructure-collapse.title: Public infrastructure shows signs of collapse
infrastructure-collapse.body: Failures in essential services become more frequent, disrupting daily life.

attack-foiled.title: Assassination attempt against the president foiled
attack-foiled.body: Security forces stop the attack; the country breathes a sigh of relief.

attack-fatal.title: President killed in assassination attempt
attack-fatal.body: The country mourns the fatal loss of the head of state.

coup.title: Military seizes power in a coup
coup.body: Troops occupy public buildings and depose the civilian government.

revolution.title: Revolution topples the government
revolution.body: Crowds take to the streets as the government loses control of the country.

rebels-emerge.title: Rebel groups emerge in the countryside
rebels-emerge.body: Isolated communities report the presence of armed fighters.

recession-starts.title: Country officially enters recession
recession-starts.body: Economic indicators confirm the contraction in activity.

recession-ends.title: Country exits recession
recession-ends.body: Indicators show a recovery in economic activity.

election.title: Election · end of term {{term}}
election.lost: You lost the election. The opposition governed for four years without undoing your policies. Run again.
election.heading: Pick up to {{max}} promises
election.hint: The group that likes a promise reacts badly if it isn't kept by the end of the term.
election.noPrevious: First election: you took office without promises.
election.honeymoon: Honeymoon possible: with a margin of 20 points or more, up to 2 actions in the 1st semester cost half. Projected margin: {{margin}}.
election.ifLose: If you lose, you follow the new government and can run again at the next election.

regimes.title: Regimes & utopias

req.authoritarianism: Stage 1 requires a crisis or high approval

regimes.utopiasHint: Require complete trees + minimum indicators, held for {{turns}} consecutive turns without coup, revolution or assassination

anarcho-capitalist.name: Anarcho-capitalist
anarcho-capitalist.indicators: Tax ≈ 0%; high GDP; crime under control

theocracy.name: Theocracy
theocracy.indicators: Religious as the largest group; high religious support

technocracy.name: Technocracy / ecotopia
technocracy.indicators: Minimal pollution; high education and health
